name: vrs-lib
description: Restores this thread's exact pre-compaction originals (vrs_restore) and byte ranges of its rollout (vrs_read). SWEGCA VRS-MRP: Verification-Reinforced Synapse, Memory Recovery Plugin.

interface.longDescription: After this thread is compacted, vrs_restore returns the exact user messages and answers that left the live context, with their rollout positions and SHA-256; vrs_read returns an exact byte range of the rollout.
